content: Another powerful trend shaping the market is the inexorable rise of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) pressures. This trend forces contractors to view their service not just through the lens of cost and productivity, but also through the lens of environmental stewardship. The traditional model of competing solely on the price per meter drilled is becoming obsolete.
